title: YouTube Clipper for Christian Content Creator (12M+ Followers)
description:
**YouTube Clipper for Christian Content Creator (12M+ Followers)**



Hey! I'm Mike Malagies, an independent Christian content creator with over 12 million followers across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and
. I post 2-3 long-form YouTube videos every week (usually 10 to 20 minutes each), and I'm looking for someone to turn those videos into short-form clips for TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts, and
.



**What you'll be doing:**



- Watching my 2 weekly YouTube videos and pulling out the strongest 
nts to turn into short-form clips 

- Editing each clip to be vertical 9:16, 30-90 seconds long, with clean captions, smooth cuts, and good pacing.

- Following a brand guide I'll send you so every clip looks and feels like mine.

- Delivering finished clips through Google Drive or 
.



**What I'm looking for:**



- At least 1 to 2 years of short-form video editing experience (TikTok, Reels, Shorts).

- Strong with CapCut, Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve.

- Excellent English comprehension. You need to understand what I'm saying in my videos to find the best 
nts to clip.

- A good eye for storytelling. The best clips have a hook, a build, and a payoff. I want someone who can spot those 
nts, not just chop random sections.

- Bonus if you're a Christian or comfortable working with faith-based content. My videos are about Jesus, the Bible, prayer, and walking with God. This needs to be content you're okay editing every week.

- Bonus if you have experience clipping podcasts or long-form content into shorts.



**The setup:**



- Project-based to start, with the goal of building a long-term ongoing relationship.

- We'll start with a paid trial: I'll send you one of my recent YouTube videos and ask you to produce 5 short-form clips so I can see your style. 

- After the trial, if it's a fit, we'll lock in a per-video rate (my budget is flexible based on quality and turnaround) 

- There's room to grow into more work over time (daily short-form editing, thumbnails, etc.) if it goes well.



**To apply, please send:**



1. 2 to 3 examples of short-form clips you've made from long-form content (podcast clips, YouTube shorts, sermon clips, etc.).

2. A short note (3 to 5 sentences) telling me why you'd be a good fit. Don't copy and paste a template. Mention something specific about my content or this job so I know you actually read this.

3. Your timezone and your typical working hours.

4. The word "BLESSED" somewhere in your application so I know you read the full posting.



Looking forward to finding the right person. If you do good work, this can turn into a long-term role with real growth potential.



God bless,

Mike

title: Content Writer & Copywriter
description:
We are looking for an experienced, talented Content Writer to help us grow our digital presence, strengthen our brand voice, and produce high-quality written content across our website, blog, and marketing channels.

This is not a role for someone who leans on AI to generate content. We want a writer who understands B2B communication, can translate technical packaging topics into clear and compelling copy, and can develop a confident, consistent voice that resonates with procurement managers, supply chain directors, and sustainability leads at major food and beverage companies.

You will work closely with the Bridge Johnson team, and there will be variety in the content you produce — from long-form blog articles and case studies to website page copy, social media posts, and
 campaigns.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Write clear, engaging, and well-researched blog articles and thought leadership pieces on packaging, sustainability, supply chain, and FMCG topics

• Produce and refine website copy across product pages, landing pages, and the Packaging Academy section

• Write compelling case studies that showcase Bridge Johnson's real-world client results

• Draft
 campaigns, newsletters, and follow-up sequences for lead nurturing

• Create social media content (primarily LinkedIn) that is professional, insightful, and on-brand

• Develop and maintain a consistent brand voice across all written touchpoints

• Conduct online research to ensure content is accurate, current, and relevant to our target audience

• Optimise content for SEO, including use of keywords, meta descriptions, and internal linking — without sacrificing readability

• Collaborate with the design and web team to ensure written content works well alongside visuals and page layouts



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

• Minimum 3 years of professional content writing or copywriting experience

• Native or near-native English writing ability — exceptional grammar, vocabulary, and tone are essential

• Demonstrable experience writing for B2B audiences, ideally in industrial, technical, or sustainability sectors

• Strong SEO knowledge and experience writing content that ranks, not just reads well

• Ability to research and write about unfamiliar technical topics with accuracy and confidence

• Experience producing long-form content (1,000–2,000+ word articles) as well as short, punchy copy

• LinkedIn content experience — understanding of what performs in a professional B2B context

• Highly organised, able to manage deadlines and work independently with minimal hand-holding

• Comfortable communicating with a UK-based team across different time zones via video call and messaging



NICE TO HAVE

• Experience in packaging, logistics, supply chain, FMCG, or sustainability sectors

• Familiarity with HubSpot, WordPress, or other CMS/CRM platforms

• Basic understanding of
 marketing platforms (Mailchimp, HubSpot, etc.)

• Experience with keyword research tools such as SEMrush, or Google Search Console



IMPORTANT

We value original thinking and genuine writing talent. We are not looking for candidates who use AI tools to generate the majority of their content, or who submit AI-written work as their own. Your writing samples must be your own original work. We will be able to tell the difference, and misrepresenting this will result in immediate disqualification.

We also need someone confident enough to push back on a brief if they think a different angle would work better. We want a partner in content — not just someone to execute a list



How to Apply



Please include all of the following with your application:

• A cover letter in your own words — tell us about your writing background and why this role appeals to you

• Your CV / resume, including tools, platforms, and sectors you have written for

• 3 writing samples — ideally including at least one long-form article and one piece of web copy (links preferred)

• A short Loom video (60–90 seconds) — introduce yourself and talk through one piece of writing you are particularly proud of and why

• If you have a personal blog, LinkedIn profile, or published bylines, please include links

To confirm you have read this posting in full, please include the word SUSTAINABLE at the top of your cover letter or application message. Applications without this will not be reviewed.

You will be the right hand to the Founder/Visionary, owning day-to-day execution of business development and pre-sales across three lanes:

- Salesforce Consulting Pre-Sales - Lead discovery calls, scope opportunities, build SOWs, deliver demos to mid-market and SLED prospects, and convert qualified leads into signed engagements.

- FMEAi Product Go-to-Market - Run product demos, qualify SaaS leads, support AppExchange listing efforts, and help convert pilots into paying customers across manufacturing accounts.

- US Government Contracting (SLED + Federal) - Identify RFPs/RFQs/RFIs on state procurement portals, and bid-tracking platforms; lead proposal writing and compilation; coordinate teaming partners; manage submission timelines.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



Business Development & Pre-Sales

- Generate and qualify outbound pipeline for Salesforce consulting and FMEAi SaaS.

- Conduct discovery calls, scoping sessions, and live product demos via Zoom/Teams.

- Build proposals, SOWs, pricing models, capability statements, and pitch decks.

- Maintain CRM hygiene (HubSpot/Salesforce); track pipeline, forecast accurately, report weekly.

- Support marketing on case studies, datasheets, and AppExchange positioning.



US Government Contracting (SLED & Federal)

- Daily monitoring of SAM.gov, GovWin, state/local procurement portals, and education bid sites.

title: Talented Designer / Illustrator for Music/Entertainment Brand
description:
We have spent the past decade doing youth mental health work inside fandoms — at concerts, in fan communities, with artists, on tours. The work has reached over half a million people. We're now building the next generation of what we do — a toolkit of fan-native experiences that meet young people in the language they already speak (music, lyrics, concerts, fandom, parasocial culture) and quietly deliver the protective factors that research shows actually keep adolescents alive.



The first tool is launching this summer with a major fan community as the founding partner. Several more are in development.



We're a small team. The founder is an established leader, a lifelong fangirl, and an experienced Fortune 500 communications strategist. The engineer is in place. The founding fans are in. The strategy is in.

We need one more thing: someone with real taste and real chops to make this look like nothing else in the youth mental health space — because everything in the youth mental health space looks the same and the work has not changed lives at scale.



What we're looking for

Someone who can move between identity systems, editorial layouts, illustrated artifacts, motion-adjacent thinking, and physical print design without losing voice along the way.



You should have

>> A portfolio with a clear point of view, not just polish

>> Senior-level Figma chops, Adobe CC fluency, real illustration ability

>> Typographic literacy — actual hierarchy, real scale, considered weight

>> Your saved inspiration looks like A24, Mubi, Apartamento, Saddle Creek album art, vintage concert ephemera, indie zines, risograph prints, and editorial design from publications people actually pay for

>> You've been a fan of something so hard it shaped who you are

>> You can design for a 16-year-old fan and a 45-year-old A&R exec without changing who you are



You're NOT our person if

Structure

>> Open to contract per project, ongoing retainer, or a path to full-time founding role.

title: Book Interior Formatter
description:
About the Role • Per-Project Pay

We are a publishing services company helping authors bring their books to life. We are looking for a talented, detail-oriented, and creatively driven Book Interior Formatter to join our freelance team on a per-project basis. In this role, you will be responsible for transforming author manuscripts into beautifully formatted, professionally designed, publication-ready books — both in print and digital formats.



This is not just a technical formatting role. We expect our formatter to bring a strong design sensibility to every project, creating interior layouts that feel intentional, polished, and cohesive with the book's cover design. Every book that leaves our team should look like it belongs on a professional bookstore shelf.

You will work directly with our team, receiving the manuscript, cover files, and project brief for each author assigned to you. From there you are responsible for taking the project from raw manuscript all the way through to fully completed, Amazon KDP upload-ready deliverables — handling everything in between including layout design, typography, image placement, ePub creation, and revisions.



This is a fully remote, freelance position. You will be paid per project, giving you the flexibility to manage your own schedule while taking on work as projects are assigned to you.



Compensation:

Pay is per project based on the length and complexity of the book:

Under 200 pages — $125 USD

200 to 350 pages — $175 USD

350+ pages or heavy interior design — $200 USD

ePub / Reflowable eBook (when required) — $40 USD



The ePub is a separate deliverable and will only be assigned when the author requires a digital edition. Not all projects will include this. The rate for each project will be confirmed with you at the time of assignment. Invoices are to be submitted on the 1st and 15th of each month for all projects fully completed within that period. Any project not yet completed by the invoice date simply rolls over to the next invoice date. Payment will be processed within 5–7 business days of receiving your invoice.



What You'll Be Doing:

Receiving author manuscripts and transforming them into complete, professionally formatted book interiors from start to finish

Designing interior layouts that are visually compelling, easy to read, and consistent with the overall aesthetic and tone of the book's cover design

Making intentional typography choices including font selection, sizing, spacing, kerning, leading, drop caps, and hierarchy to elevate the reading experience

Setting up and managing master pages, paragraph styles, character styles, and object styles in Adobe InDesign for clean, consistent, and efficient formatting

Handling front matter and back matter including title pages, copyright pages, dedication pages, table of contents, author bios, and acknowledgments

Placing and optimizing images, infographics, and design elements within the interior layout with proper resolution and color settings for print

Preparing and exporting print-ready PDF files to Amazon KDP specifications including correct trim sizes, bleed, margins, and embedded fonts

Creating reflowable ePub files for Amazon KDP digital publishing, ensuring proper structure, metadata, and compatibility with Kindle devices

Uploading and verifying files through Amazon KDP’s previewer to confirm everything renders correctly before final submission

Communicating clearly with our team throughout the project and making revisions based on author and team feedback until full approval is given

Managing your project pipeline and meeting deadlines reliably across multiple active projects



Required Skills & Experience:

Proficiency in Adobe InDesign — this is a must

Working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator for handling image assets and design elements

Strong understanding of Amazon KDP print requirements including trim sizes, bleed settings, margin guidelines, and file specifications

Experience creating reflowable ePub files for Amazon KDP — knowledge of ePub structure, metadata, and KDP digital upload requirements

Solid understanding of typography — font pairing, spacing, kerning, leading, and hierarchy

Experience formatting a variety of book genres including non-fiction, self-help, business, memoir, and fiction

Ability to work with supplied cover designs and match the interior style and aesthetic accordingly

Strong attention to detail with a keen eye for alignment, consistency, and overall visual polish

Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines

Reliable internet connection and ability to communicate clearly in English



Nice to Have:

Familiarity with ISBN placement, copyright page formatting, and front/back matter layout conventions

Experience with color management and print production for books with full color interiors

Background in working with non-fiction, business, self-help, or memoir genres

Experience working with heavily designed or image-rich layouts such as workbooks or journals



What We Provide:

Adobe Creative Cloud subscription — we cover your software costs

Book cover files and design assets for each project

Clear project briefs and author details at the time of assignment

A collaborative, supportive team environment

Consistent project flow as our author roster grows



Confidentiality & NDA:

All tea
mbers are required to sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) before beginning any work with us. By joining our team you agree to keep all author information, project details, and company materials strictly confidential.

Additionally, please note that any work completed for our authors — including interior layouts, formatted files, and all related deliverables — is the exclusive property of our company and our authors. You will not be permitted to use, display, or reference any work completed for us in your portfolio, on social media, or in any other public or professional capacity. We take the privacy and confidentiality of our authors very seriously and appreciate your understanding and respect of this policy.



How to Apply:

If this sounds like the right fit for you, we would love to hear from you! 



A brief introduction about yourself and your formatting experience

Portfolio or samples of previous interior layout work (print and/or ePub)

Your Adobe software proficiency level

A personalized video directed to Branding by Books introducing yourself, walking us through your experience and workflow, and sharing why you would like to work with our team. Feel free to submit your video however is most convenient for you — a Google Drive link, YouTube unlisted link, or any other method that works for you

Any questions you may have about the role



We look forward to working with you and creating beautiful books together.

title: Virtual Assistant for Water Restoration Business Owner (Long-Term Role)
description:
Second Brain / Executive Right Hand VA for US Business Owner ($10/hr)



We're hiring ONE exceptional person to be the second brain of a US-based business owner in the  water restoration space. This is not a task-rabbit role. We are looking for someone who can step into his world, understand how he thinks, and quietly run the parts of his business that are eating his time.



If you're a top-tier VA who is bored doing data entry and wants to actually run something, keep reading.



WHAT THIS ROLE REALLY IS

The owner spends most of his time on the field side of the business: serving customers, leading his team, and growing the company. He needs a sharp person beside him handling the office side so he can stay focused. The scope is intentionally broad because the goal is not "complete these 10 tasks." The goal is: give the owner his time back and make sure nothing slips through the cracks.



Day to day this will involve things like managing his inbox, following up on paperwork, coordinating with customers and vendors, keeping his calendar sane, and chasing down whatever is open. The specifics will evolve as we figure out what helps him most.



WHO YOU ARE

- You think two steps ahead. You don't wait to be told what to do. If you see something falling through the cracks, you catch it

- Your written English is clean enough that US customers and vendors can't tell you're not in the office

- Your spoken English is confident on the phone. Yes, you will be on calls

- You are organized to the point that other people find you a little intense about it

- You document everything. You follow up until things actually close

- You're honest. If you make a mistake, you tell the owner before he finds out himself

- You're allergic to dropping balls. You build systems so you don't have to remember everything

- Comfortable picking up new software fast. Construction or home services experience is a plus but not required



NON-NEGOTIABLES

- This must be your ONLY job. No other clients, no other VA gigs, no side hustles. We are paying above market specifically so you don't have to split your focus. If you currently have other clients, you'll need to be ready to wind them down before starting

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, US business hours (Eastern time)

- Quiet dedicated workspace, fast internet, backup power, dedicated computer

- You're in this for the long haul. We are not interested in someone who will leave in 6 months





HOW TO APPLY

We will get a lot of applications. To save us both time, follow these instructions exactly. Anything missing gets deleted without a reply.



1. Subject line: "SECOND BRAIN - [your name] - [your current city]"



2. Confirm in writing: "I understand this must be my only job, and I have no other current clients or commitments that would conflict." If you have current clients, tell me your plan and timeline to wind them down.



3. Tell me, in your own words and not from a template: what is the difference between a good assistant and a great one? Two or three sentences. We want to see how you think, not how well you can Google.



4. Tell me about a time you caught a mistake your boss or client was about to make, and what you did about it. One short paragraph.



5. List every other job, client, or side project you currently have. Be honest. If we find out later you hid something, that's an immediate end.



6. Record a 60 to 90 second Loom or video of yourself introducing yourself in English. We want to hear how you talk and see your workspace.



7. Send a screenshot of your internet speed test (
 or speedtest.net) and tell us your backup plan when your power or internet goes down.



8. Your earliest start date, and confirmation you can work US business hours.



Looking forward to meeting the right person.



Best way to contact me is on whatsapp: (480)

title: Senior OA Sourcer - Amazon FBA (US Market)
description:
Compensation: 1,000 USD / month

Location: Fully Remote

Schedule: Monday to Friday, day shift (Philippines time)

Employment Type: Full-time

Pay Frequency: Monthly



Job Overview

This is a sourcing role for a US-based Amazon FBA seller who's been in the game for six years, running a store focused mainly on electronics and tech. Think Logitech, DJI, Garmin, SteelSeries, Skullcandy, and similar brands. The store is growing and needs a sourcer who can come in and hit the ground running, not someone who needs months of hand-holding to get the basics down.



You'll be finding online arbitrage leads - manually browsing supplier sites, using reverse sourcing to find new brands and stores, and reading Keepa charts to evaluate whether a lead is actually worth buying. You'll submit your leads through a custom internal platform, and the manager (a senior VA with 4+ years on the team) will review and approve before purchasing. The client is hands-on when needed but expects you to be self-driven and ask questions when you're unsure - not stay quiet and guess.



Responsibilities

• Find online arbitrage leads through manual sourcing - browsing supplier websites, checking clearance pages, tracking sales and promotions across retailer sites

• Use reverse sourcing to discover new suppliers and brands that fit the store's niche (electronics, tech, and other approved categories)

• Evaluate leads using Keepa - check sales rank history, price trends, offer count, and seasonality before submitting

• Submit leads through the client's internal platform with relevant data (buy cost, sell price, potential ROI, source link)

• Avoid re-submitting leads that have already been reviewed, bought, or rejected - keep track of what's been posted

• Communicate actively in 
 - post leads, ask questions, flag anything uncertain rather than guessing

• Stay consistent with the categories and niche guidelines the manager provides, while also flagging good opportunities outside those categories if you spot them



Requirements

• At least 4 years of hands-on OA sourcing experience for a US Amazon FBA store

• Strong working knowledge of Keepa - you know how to read a chart, interpret sales rank trends, and use offer count data to evaluate a lead

• Solid understanding of manual sourcing and reverse sourcing - you have a process, not just a list of sites to check

• Familiar with how buy box works - fulfillment method, pricing, inventory levels, regional distribution

• Understands OA concepts like orphan ASINs, seasonality, supply and demand dynamics - not just surface-level familiarity

• Good English communication - you're comfortable asking for clarification and flagging problems without waiting to be asked

• Reliable internet connection and a computer set up for this kind of work



Nice to Have (Not Required)

• Experience sourcing in electronics, tech, or adjacent categories (gadgets, accessories, peripherals)

• Familiarity with tools like Flip Alert or similar price/alert monitoring tools

• Experience working with a custom order management or lead tracking platform

• Comfortable with subscribe-and-save sourcing or experience sourcing from brands like Garmin, DJI, Logitech, SteelSeries, or similar

• Previous experience where the sourcer worked somewhat independently and interfaced with a senior manager rather than needing daily oversight from the owner

description:
About the Role

We're a U.S.-based commercial general contractor looking for a full-time Construction Accounting VA who can own our pay application billing cycle from end to end. You'll work directly inside Sage Intacct as our primary accounting/ERP system and coordinate with Procore through the Sage Intacct/Procore connector. This role is for someone who has already done construction accounting for a commercial GC — not a general bookkeeper looking to transition.



You'll partner closely with our project coordinator on compliance (lien waivers, insurance) and sub pay app review, but the accounting is yours to own.



Key Responsibilities:

- Manage the pay application billing cycle end to end — coordinating between owner/client, subcontractors, and vendors for timely and accurate billing

- Differentiate between subcontractor pay applications and vendor invoices — flagging discrepancies before processing

- Oversee Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) — processing invoices, tracking receivables, and reconciling activity

- Perform credit card costing and expense allocation — coding charges to the correct project, cost code, and ledger account

- Maintain and review balance sheets — supporting month-end close and keeping financial records audit-ready

- Work within Sage Intacct as the primary accounting and ERP system — entering, tracking, and reconciling financial data across active projects

- Use Procore for construction management touchpoints — coordinating through the ERP connector integration between Sage Intacct and Procore

- Partner with the project coordinator on sub pay app review and compliance verification before payments are released

- Support general construction accounting functions as directed — adapting as the role's scope grows with the company



Requirements (Must-Haves):

- Prior accounting experience with a commercial general contractor (this is non-negotiable)

- Proficient in Sage Intacct as a primary accounting/ERP system

- Familiar with Procore and the Sage Intacct / Procore ERP integration

- Strong understanding of construction pay app billing cycles and AP/AR

- Able to provide 3–5 character references from similar past roles

- Excellent written and verbal English communication

- Reliable tech setup: PC, fast internet, and a backup plan for power outages



Nice to Have:

- Bluebeam experience — PDF markup, invoice review, construction document handling

- Hands-on experience with lien waiver collection and insurance compliance tracking for commercial subcontractors

- Experience with ERP connector / integration workflows between accounting and construction management platforms

- Prior month-end close, audit prep, or balance sheet ownership in a commercial construction setting

We are seeking a skilled and dedicated Amazon Virtual Assistant with a strong background in product research across UK, and European markets, including Germany, Spain, France, and Italy (potentially in the US in the future). The selected candidate will work exclusively(!) for our company as a Virtual Assistant and will be responsible for sourcing high-potential products from top wholesalers and retailers, optimizing listings, and using data-driven insights to maximize profitability. This position includes a 3-month probationary period to ensure a strong fit with our team and goals.



About Us



Our company is a forward-thinking, rapidly expanding e-commerce company specializing in online arbitrage and wholesale. Our team thrives on innovation, efficiency, and a commitment to excellence. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a talented and experienced Amazon Virtual Assistant/Product Researcher to play a key role in our success.



Key Responsibilities



-Conduct comprehensive product research for UK and EU markets, particularly in Germany, Spain, France, and Italy.

-Source products exclusively from reputable retailers and wholesalers.

-Optimize listings to achieve a minimum ROI of 30% and maintain a Best Seller Rank (BSR) of 1-2%.

-Leverage tools like SellerToolkit, BuyBotPro, Scan Unlimited and Keepa for detailed market analysis.

-While we prefer experience with the tools mentioned above, we welcome familiarity with other/similar tools and encourage new sourcing methods.

-Use Trustpilot for vendor and market research.

-Maintain knowledge of Microsoft Excel.

-Manage and optimize Seller Central to ensure efficient listing management, order processing, and overall account health.

-Provide outstanding customer service and support throughout the sales journey.



Requirements



-Proven experience as an Amazon Virtual Assistant or Product Researcher, with a focus on the EU and UK markets.

-In-depth understanding of sourcing products from multiple European wholesalers.

-Proficiency in English (fluency in another European language is a plus).

-Experience with BuyBotPro, Scan Unlimited and Keepa for market analysis.

-Track record of achieving a minimum ROI of 30% and a BSR of 1-2%.

-Familiarity with the UK and EU markets and experience. 

-Reliable, high-speed internet connection.

-Familiarity with the US market, private label, selling on Etsy and other alternative platforms is a plus.



Benefits



-Competitive Salary: 20,000–25,000 PHP/month, based on experience.

-Additional Performance-Based Bonuses

-Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy the benefits of working remotely with a flexible schedule.

-Professional Growth: Opportunities for career development and access to the latest tools and resources.

-Collaborative Team: Be part of a dynamic team passionate about e-commerce and innovation.



How to Apply



If you’re excited about this opportunity and meet the requirements, please follow these steps:



1. Include a brief, compelling statement explaining why you would be the best fit for our team. 

2. Submit your resume with your most recent and relevant experience.

3. Provide a reference that highlights your skills and achievements in Amazon product research and sourcing.

4. A screenshot of your current internet speed test results (using tools like Speedtest.net or similar).

title: Youtube Video Editor
description:
Project-based · Remote · Philippines preferred · Long-term · ~4 videos/month · Pay based on quality · Slack +
 only



About Us

Revive Amazon Partners is a U.S.-based Amazon growth agency helping better-for-you CPG brands scale to seven and eight figures. We create educational, thought leadership video content for YouTube that supports client acquisition and we need a skilled editor who can help us do it well.



The Role

We're looking for a reliable, detail-oriented YouTube video editor who moves fast, communicates clearly, and exercises real editorial judgment. This is not a "do only what I'm told" role, but it's also not a freestyle creative role. We want thoughtful execution within clear direction.

You'll receive raw footage (talking head video, screen recordings where applicable) along with brand assets — color palette, nameplate, graphics, and any specific edit notes. Beyond that, we expect you to use good judgment: if there's a long stretch of talking head footage, add subtle engagement elements — B-roll, zooms, motion, text emphasis — without being distracting. If you need something from us to do the job right, ask. We'd rather you ask than leave a gap.



What You'll Do

— Edit 3–8 minute YouTube videos with clean pacing and strong viewer retention

— Apply specific cut, blur, overlay, and graphic notes as provided

— Proactively add engagement-enhancing visuals during talking head segments

— Deliver first edits within 3 business days; revisions within 1 day

— Apply feedback accurately and consistently across videos

— Communicate proactively via Slack and
 throughout every project

Nice to have: Create YouTube thumbnails in Canva · Clip short-form content from long-form footage



Non-Negotiables

Please don't apply if these don't describe you.

— You proactively improve engagement — you don't wait to be told every enhancement

— You respond reliably during agreed working hours

— You communicate proactively when timelines shift

— You want consistent, long-term, project-based work

If you need repeat reminders or are slow to respond, this role is not a fit.



What We're Looking For

— Portfolio examples of educational, talking head-style videos (5–8 min) for entrepreneurs or business audiences

— Good editorial instincts — knowing when and how to add visual interest

— High attention to detail and a fast-turnaround mindset

— Clear, proactive communication

Bonus: Experience with thumbnails in Canva · Short-form clips from long-form content · E-commerce or Amazon-related content



Compensation & Process

Pay is per project and based on the quality of your work. Rates may be revisited after consistency and reliability are established. The right editor will have steady, ongoing work with us.

Selected candidates will first complete a short unpaid test edit (30 seconds), then — if we like what we see — a paid full-video test edit. From there, we move to a package-based working arrangement.



How to Apply

 
 first line must include the word REViVE — applications that miss this will not be reviewed.

Include:

— 1–2 sentences about yourself and your experience

— Links to videos you've edited (talking head style preferred)

— Any thumbnails you've created

— Editing and design tools you use

— Your expected pay range per video

— Your typical turnaround time for a 6-minute video

— One sentence explaining how you d
 when to add extra visuals for engagement



The best editors understand the goal of a video and enhance it without being asked. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
What This Role Actually Is

4ocean pulls plastic out of oceans, rivers, and coastlines, and turns the story of that work into a brand that customers want to be part of. Social media is how most of the
et us.



This role is the daily engine behind that. You take direction from the e-commerce and marketing leads and turn it into posts that go live, on time, on brand, every day. You ideate inside the strategy we set. You build the assets. You schedule the posts. You answer the comments and DMs. You boost what is working and run the simple paid campaigns we hand you. You report the numbers back honestly. This is an executor role, not a strategist role. The brand voice, the campaign themes, and the testing priorities come from us. The shipping, the polish, and the steady daily output come from you. We are not looking for someone who waits for instructions on every post. We are looking for someone who runs a calendar inside a clear playbook

and makes a hundred small, good decisions a week without needing to escalate them.



What Success Looks Like:

Three months in, the daily content engine runs without me chasing it. The calendar is full two weeks out. Posts go live when they are supposed to, formatted right for each platform, with captions that sound like 4ocean. Community responses do not pile up unread. Reporting shows up Monday mornings without being asked for, and it tells me

something I can act on.



Six months in, you are bringing me content angles and trend ideas I had not thought of, and a meaningful share of them are working. Boosted posts and the small paid campaigns you run are improving on basic metrics. You know our audience better than I do on a day-to-day level because you are living in the feeds and the comments.



What You'll Do

Organic Content Production

• Build the short-form vertical video we post to TikTok and Instagram Reels, mostly

editing from existing footage, b-roll, and creator content using CapCut, etc..

• Design static posts and carousels in Canva using the brand kit and templates we provide.

• Write captions in 4ocean's voice. We will give you examples, voice guidelines, and feedback in the first weeks until it lands consistently.

• Pitch three to five content ideas per week that connect to current trends, ocean and sustainability news, or product 
nts. We pick what ships.



Calendar, Posting, and Scheduling

• Maintain the weekly and monthly content calendar in Asana. Two-week rolling visibility minimum.

• Schedule and publish across Instagram, TikTok,
, and any new channels we add. Right format, right copy, right hashtags, right time for each platform.

• Coordinate with the e-commerce and
 teams so social posts line up with launches, promos, and lifecycle campaigns.



Community Management

• First-line responses to comments and DMs across all channels. Standard responses for FAQs, escalation to customer service or me for anything sensitive, off-script, or PR-adjacent.

• Flag negative sentiment, recurring complaints, or PR risks the same day they appear.

• Engage with creators, partners, and customers who tag us. Build the habit of conversation, not just broadcasting.



Paid Social Execution

• Boost organic posts that are earning it, using the rules we set together.

• Set up and duplicate ad sets in Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager from briefs we provide. Audiences, placements, budgets, creative uploads, naming conventions.

• Swap creative on running campaigns, refresh assets on a regular cadence, pause underperformers when they hit our thresholds.

• This is not media buying. You are not building strategy from scratch. You are running the playbook we hand you, cleanly and consistently.



Reporting

• Weekly numbers every Monday. Reach, engagement, follower growth per channel, top three and bottom three posts of the week, paid spend and basic performance against the targets we set.

• Short written commentary, two or three sentences, on what stood out and what you would try next.

• Monthly roll-up with trend notes for our review.



Who Thrives Here

Someone who:

• Treats deadlines as real and a content calendar as a commitment, not a suggestion.

• Has strong written English and can write a caption that sounds like a brand, not a translation.

• Edits short-form vertical video fast and well in CapCut. Not perfectly cinematic. Native to the platform.

• Is comfortable inside Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager from clear instructions.

• Notices things. Sees a comment trend, a competitor move, a 
 cycle, and surfaces it without being asked.

• Asks good questions early and does not let small ambiguities become missed

posts.



If you need someone to walk you through every step every day, this will not work. If you want to run a daily operation inside a clear system and grow into more responsibility as you prove it, this is the role.



Experience That Matters

• Two-plus years running social media for a brand, an agency, or a meaningful number of clients. DTC and ecommerce experience preferred.

• Portfolio showing real short-form vertical edits you have shipped, not just stock template work.

• Hands-on experience inside Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager. Not certifications. Actual campaigns you have set up and managed.

• Comfortable in Asana or a similar project management tool. We run our entire operation in Asana.

title: Independent Advertising Sales Partner
description:
JOB TITLE: Independent Advertising Sales Partner TYPE: Independent Contractor (1099) — Commission-Based LOCATION: Remote · Worldwide (187 Countries) HOURS: Flexible · Set Your Own Schedule START DATE: Immediate · Rolling Applications SECTOR: Digital Media · B2G · B2B · Municipal / Government



ABOUT MAYORS & CITIES



Mayors & Cities is the premier worldwide municipalities magazine connecting city leaders, government officials, urban planners, and public policy professionals across 187 countries. Published by Secusysts Technologies Inc. (Wilmington, DE, USA), our platform delivers authoritative content on city governance, urban innovation, infrastructure, sustainability, and global municipal cooperation.



We serve a highly engaged audience of mayors, deputy mayors, city council members, municipal administrators, and B2G decision-makers — making us one of the most targeted media channels for organizations seeking direct access to city leadership worldwide.



THE OPPORTUNITY



We are expanding our global advertising sales network and seeking driven, entrepreneurial Independent Advertising Sales Partners to represent Mayors & Cities to advertisers, sponsors, and institutional partners in their regions.



This is a remote, commission-based opportunity with no ceiling on earnings. You set your own schedule, work your existing network, and earn competitive commissions on every campaign you close — with performance bonuses for top producers.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Prospect and acquire new advertisers across government, NGO, corporate, and institutional sectors

Present and sell Mayors & Cities advertising packages: display advertising, sponsored content, newsletter sponsorships, city spotlights, special supplements, and event promotions

Manage the full sales cycle, outreach, pitch, proposal, negotiation, close

Build long-term relationships with advertisers and renew accounts each cycle

Coordinate with the editorial team on campaign delivery and creative assets

Submit signed Insertion Orders and ensure smooth campaign onboarding

Provide market intelligence and feedback on advertiser needs in your territory



ADVERTISING PACKAGES YOU WILL SELL



Display Advertising — Banners, sidebar, and in-article placements. Ideal for corporations and NGOs.

Sponsored Content — Branded editorial articles. Ideal for governments and development agencies.

Newsletter Sponsorship —
 placement directly to city leaders. Ideal for tech and smart-city firms.

City Spotlight — Dedicated feature on a city or region. Ideal for city governments and tourism boards.

Event Promotion — Conference and summit visibility. Ideal for event organizers and UN agencies.

Special Supplement — Thematic branded issue. Ideal for multilateral institutions and corporations.

Featured Book / Press Release — Author and organization visibility. Ideal for think tanks and foundations.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Proven track record in media sales, advertising sales, or B2G/B2B business development

Existing network in government, public affairs, NGOs, or institutional sectors (a strong asset)

Self-motivated, results-driven, comfortable working independently

Strong written and verbal communication skills — English required; additional languages a plus

Understanding of digital media, content marketing, and advertiser ROI

Professional, reliable, representing the Mayors & Cities brand with integrity

Familiarity with municipal government or public policy is a significant plus

COMPENSATION & COMMISSION STRUCTURE



This is a commission-only arrangement. No salary, base pay, draw, or advance is provided. You earn directly from what you close — with no cap on earnings.



Commissions are paid on Net Revenue (gross advertising revenue actually received by the Publisher, less any refunds, chargebacks, agency discounts, or authorized deductions) from campaigns closed by you each calendar month, at the following tiered rates:



$0.01 — $9,999.99 per month: 20% commission on entire monthly net revenue in this tier.

$10,000.00 — $24,999.99 per month: 25% commission on entire monthly net revenue once the $10K threshold is reached.

$25,000.00 and above per month: 30% commission on entire monthly net revenue once the $25K threshold is reached.

Example: If you close $12,000 in net revenue in a given month, the applicable rate is 25%, resulting in a commission of $3,000 for that month.



Additional Terms:



Commissions are earned only upon the Publisher's actual receipt of cleared payment from the advertiser. No commission is owed on invoiced but uncollected amounts.

The Sales Partner is solely responsible for all costs and expenses incurred in performing services (travel, communications, marketing) unless expressly pre-approved in writing by the Publisher.

WHAT WE OFFER



Commission rates of 20%, 25%, and 30?sed on monthly net revenue tier

No earnings cap — the more you close, the more you earn

Full access to Mayors & Cities media kit, rate cards, and sales collateral

Dedicated editorial and campaign team support to help you close deals

Freedom to work from anywhere in the world on your own schedule

The prestige of representing an internationally recognized municipal media brand

Potential to grow into a Regional Sales Director role as the network expands

NOTE: This is a 1099 Independent Contractor opportunity — not a salaried position. Compensation is exclusively commission-based with no earnings cap.



HOW TO APPLY



Send your application to: 
 Subject line: "Sales Partner Application – [Your Name / Region]"



Please include:



A brief introduction: your sales background and relevant experience

Your target territory or region (city, country, or global)

Any relevant sector expertise (government, NGO, corporate, media, etc.)

Your LinkedIn profile or professional portfolio (optional but recommended)

title: Operations & Supplier Management & Customer Service | Custom Merchandise Brand
description:
Summary

We're a fast-growing Dutch brand making custom branded merchandise for pilates and fitness studios worldwide. Our products ship under multiple labels, manufactured across several factories in Asia. We're a small, ambitious team and we work hard, have fun doing it, and take real pride in what we build together.

We're looking for someone who fits that same energy.



What this role is

This is a Virtual Assistant role, but not the kind where you respond to
s and update spreadsheets on autopilot. We need someone talented, proactive, and detail-obsessed who can own two key pillars of our daily operations without hand-holding: customer service and supplier coordination.



This starts as a part-time role of 4 to 5 hours per day, spread across 5 days a week. Our ambition is to grow it into a full-time position as the business scales, so we're looking for someone who wants to grow with us, not just fill a slot.



Your responsibilities

You start your day with customer service. Our clients are fitness and pilates studios around the world, and everything we make is custom. That means when something goes wrong, context matters. You'll manage incoming
s, triage complaints, and handle them proactively, from first response to resolution.



Crucially, you'll assess whether a complaint is valid: did the client receive what they actually ordered and approved? That requires a sharp eye and good judgment, not just a sympathetic reply.



Supplier coordination is the second core of this role. You'll be in daily contact with our factories, primarily via WeChat, following up on production status, confirming timelines, and keeping our tracking sheets accurate. You'll forward production orders from our internal team to the correct suppliers with the correct files.



Errors here have real consequences, so precision matters.

You'll also handle product sourcing when we need it. That means browsing Alibaba, shortlisting realistic options, and presenting a clean comparison, not just dumping links. We want someone who uses good judgment on quality, MOQ, and price before putting something in front of us.



On the logistics side, you'll monitor shipments across UPS, DHL, and FedEx, mark delivered orders in our tracking sheet, log costs to our analytics dashboard, and handle DAP shipping admin and customs documentation.



What we're looking for

Must-haves:

- Excellent written English

- Available during CET business hours, at least partially

- Comfortable with AI tools (this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have)

- Experience with customer service and complaint handling

- Experience coordinating with suppliers or manufacturers

- Highly organised and detail-oriented

- Proactive, you flag issues before they become problems

- Able to work independently without follow-up



Nice to have:

- Experience with WeChat, Alibaba, or sourcing from Asian factories

- Background in e-commerce, logistics, or operations

- Familiarity with tools like Google Sheets, Slack, and shipping portals



Show us you've done this

We're looking for A-players only. In your application, don't just tell us you're organised and proactive. Show us. Give a concrete example of a time you handled customer complaints, managed supplier relationships, or coordinated logistics across multiple vendors. Generic applications will not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a short practical assignment before a final decision is made.



If this sounds like a role you'd genuinely enjoy and a team you'd want to be part of, we want to hear from you.

description:
About us

We need a video localization specialist to turn those raw videos into polished, localized versions in Spanish, French, and Italian.



The role

You'll receive raw video (Editing is done, but there are no subtitles or voice-over) files from our creative producer and deliver finished versions with clean voice-over and accurate subtitles in the target language. This is a long-term, full-time role with consistent weekly volume.



What you'll do

- Receive raw AI-generated video ads from our creative producer (daily volume)

- Generate localized voice-overs in Spanish, French, and Italian using ElevenLabs (we'll specify voices and settings)

- Sync the voice-over to the video timing 

- Generate and style localized subtitles in the target language

- QC the voice-over: catch mispronunciations, weird emphasis, audio glitches, off-tempo delivery

- QC the subtitles: catch typos, grammar errors, awkward expressions, untranslated brand terms

- Deliver final 9:16 MP4 files ready for Meta and TikTok

- Track every delivery in our project doc



Must-haves

- Proficient with ElevenLabs (you've used it daily, you know voice settings, stability, similarity, style)

- Proficient with CapCut, Kapwing with auto subtitle or other editing app (voice-over sync, subtitle styling, auto-captions QC, font choice, timing)

- Strong attention to detail — you catch errors others miss

- Comfortable working in languages that are NOT your native language, using a rigorous verification process (DeepL reverse-translation, Google Translate cross-check, native dictionaries, AI)

- 1+ year producing video content in an e-commerce, DTC, or paid social context

- Fluent written English (you'll receive briefs and feedback in English)

- Available daily, reliable turnaround time



Nice to have

- Native or near-native Spanish, French, Italian or German (significant plus)

- Experience editing Meta Ads / TikTok Ads creative

- Knowledge of subtitle best practices (line length, reading speed, on-screen timing)

- Experience with talking-head / UGC-style ad formats



Schedule

Full-time, ~8 hours per day, 5–6 days per week. Daily delivery cycle in coordination with our creative producer.



Compensation

$500–700/month based on experience, paid monthly via PayPal or Wise. Performance bonus after 90 days.



HOW TO APPLY



Send a message with ALL 8 items below. Applications missing anything will be ignored.



1. Subject line: "E-Commerce VIDEO LOC — [Your Full Name]"

2. Short intro (3–5 sentences): who you are, why you're a fit

3. Your ElevenLabs experience: how long you've used it, which voices you've used most often, what settings you typically adjust (stability, similarity, style) and why

4. Your CapCut experience or other editing tools experience: how long, what types of videos you've edited, share 2–3 sample links if possible

5. Which languages do you speak natively or fluently? (None is acceptable — be honest)

6. Describe your exact process to verify that a Spanish, French, or Italian voice-over is correct when you don't speak the language. Be specific about tools and steps.

7. Describe your exact process to verify that subtitles in a language you don't speak are free of typos and awkward expressions.

title: Digital Marketing Coordinator

You will work from a clear system and a detailed strategy document, and you will be expected to think, not just execute.



---

- Repurposing content I provide (blogs,
s, photos, video) into on-brand captions and posts using SpeakAI and Claude

- Creating and scheduling content across Instagram,
, Google Business Profile, LinkedIn, Pinterest, and Nextdoor

- Managing and maintaining Flodesk
 sequences, templates, and monthly newsletters

- Monitoring social platforms for engagement, flagging messages and comments for my attention with a drafted response ready

- Formatting and uploading blog posts

- Designing Canva graphics using my brand templates and keeping the Canva workspace organised and current

- Tracking and reporting analytics weekly and monthly via a Notion dashboard, with your own commentary and recommendations, not just numbers

- Maintaining a clean, organised Notion workspace as the single source of truth for all tasks, content, and reporting

- Growing our audience strategically, including follower growth activity on aspirational brand accounts within our target market



---



## You Will Thrive in This Role If You



- Have a strong, independent work ethic and do not need to be told what to do next

- Can read a brand and write in its voice, not yours

- Understand the difference between content that looks good and content that converts

- Have a genuine eye for luxury aesthetics and high-end visual content

- Are fluent in AI tools, particularly Claude, and use them to work smarter, not just faster

- Understand that posting is not a strategy, and that reach without conversion is just noise

- Communicate efficiently: one consolidated message, not ten

- Can manage multiple platforms and deadlines without creating complexity

- Are proactive about learning, especially where AI tools are concerned

- Have experience working with high-ticket or luxury brands



---



## The Non-Negotiables



- Fluency in AI tools is not a nice-to-have. It is a core requirement. You will be expected to use Claude for copywriting and caption refinement, and to keep learning as the tools evolve

- Strong written English is essential. You will be representing a premium brand in every caption,
, and comment

- You must be able to work independently to a weekly schedule without daily check-ins

- Nothing goes live without approval. You will manage the pipeline and flag content for review, not post autonomously

- This role requires a genuine understanding of luxury brand positioning. Generic, motivational, or AI-obvious copy is not acceptable



---



## Tools You Will Use



- SpeakAI (primary content creation and image matching tool)

- Claude (copywriting, caption refinement, brand voice)

- Canva (design and visual content)

- Metricool (scheduling)

- Flodesk 
 marketing)

- Notion (task management, content planning, reporting)

- Google Business Profile

- Meta Business Suite

- CapCut or similar (video editing for reels)

- Loom (SOPs and process documentation)

- Fathom (Zoom recording review)

- PixieSet (client image gallery, approved folders only)

- Google Drive



---



## A Note on Brand



Charlotte Detienne Photography serves horse owners and dog owners who invest in fine art wall pieces, not digital files. The clientele is affluent, aesthetically minded, and values experience over transaction. The content needs to reflect that world: specific, observational, understated, and never generic.



If you read that and thought, "I can do generic but make it sound fancy," this is not the right role.



If you read that and immediately understood the difference, we should talk.



---



To apply, please send your resume and portfolio showing relevant work with two or three examples of content you have created for a premium or luxury brand, and a brief note on how you use AI tools in your current workflow. Include the word "equine" somewhere in your application.

title: GEO Specialist (Generative Engine Optimization)
description:
About the Role

AI-powered search is changing the way shoppers discover pools and outdoor living spaces. When a customer asks ChatGPT "luxury pool design" or uses Google AI Overviews to compare pool builders, we want Calimingo Pools to be the brand they're pointed to — and the one ranking when they search traditionally too.

We're looking for an experienced GEO Specialist to own Calimingo's entire search presence. In 2026, great GEO means mastering both the traditional foundations that Google still rewards and the AI-first strategies that determine who gets cited, recommended, and discovered on the platforms where buyers are increasingly turning first. This is a hands-on freelance role with real impact across every search surface.



What You'll Do

- Own Calimingo's full search visibility strategy — from Google rankings to AI-generated answers

- Audit our content and digital presence for discoverability, citation potential, and technical search health

- Develop keyword and topic strategies, on-page content, and link-building initiatives alongside a GEO roadmap

- Optimize product pages, category content, and editorial articles for both Google and LLM readability — structured content, clear heading hierarchies, and answer-first formats that AI engines can extract and cite

- Build Calimingo's topical authority and entity signals so search engines and AI tools alike associate our brand with luxury pools, pool design, and outdoor living

- Manage technical search foundations — site architecture, crawlability, page speed, internal linking, and Core Web Vitals

- Implement schema markup across the site (FAQPage, Product, Article, Organization) to support both rich results and AI citation

- Identify citation opportunities across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Microsoft Copilot, and Gemini

- Pursue earned media placements — features, directories, and review platforms — that strengthen both backlink profiles and AI multi-source authority

- Monitor and report on performance across all channels: organic rankings, traffic, AI citation frequency, and share of voice

- Keep content regularly refreshed with updated data and "Last Updated" signals to stay competitive in both Google and AI retrieval

- Implement and maintain content directly on the Calimingo website via WordPress





What We're Looking For



Must-have skills:

- Proven experience in Generative Engine Optimization with a strong command of the traditional search foundations that underpin it

- Strong understanding of how LLMs retrieve, rank, and cite content, including RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems

- Solid technical search skills — crawl audits, site architecture, internal linking, page speed, and Core Web Vitals

- Experience with structured data and schema markup, particularly FAQPage, Product, Article, and Organization schemas

- Experience with semantic content architecture, keyword and topic research, and entity-based strategy

- Familiarity with e-commerce content strategy and product-led search optimization

- Ability to conduct comprehensive audits and translate findings into clear, prioritized action plans

- Proficiency with search tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Google Search Console

- Proficiency with AI visibility tracking tools such as Otterly.ai, Ahrefs Brand Radar, BrightEdge, or similar

- Proficiency with ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Copilot, and Gemini for citation monitoring and testing

- WordPress proficiency — comfortable navigating, editing, and publishing content directly on the Calimingo website



Nice to have:

- Experience with digital PR and earning placements on authoritative third-party sources

- Experience with product feed optimization and merchant-facing AI platforms

- Knowledge of knowledge graph optimization and E-E-A-T signals

- Familiarity with agentic search (e.g., OpenAI Operator) and how structured content fits into agent-driven discovery workflows





What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, we expect a comprehensive audit, a prioritized roadmap, and early improvements in how Calimingo appears — in Google results and in AI-generated responses — across searches like "best luxury pool designs," "pool options," and "pool builders near me." Longer term, success means Calimingo is the brand search engines rank and AI tools reach for when someone starts dreaming about their backyard.

title: Content & Marketing Coordinator
description:
About Us



We are a growing premium jewellery e-commerce brand entering an exciting expansion phase, focused on elevated branding, strong visual storytelling, and meaningful organic audience growth.



We are looking for someone who thrives in a fast-moving, creative environment and wants to grow alongside a brand with long-term vision. This role has strong potential to evolve into a full-time senior marketing position as the business scales.



## The Role



This is primarily a content-focused role centred around organic social media, visual storytelling, and engaging brand presentation.



We are seeking a highly proactive, creatively driven, and detail-oriented Content & Marketing Coordinator who can independently execute ideas, adapt quickly to evolving systems, and maintain a consistently high standard of output without constant direction.



The ideal candidate understands how modern organic social works, has a strong eye for aesthetics and luxury presentation, and is capable of creating engaging content that feels aligned with premium fashion and jewellery brands.



While the primary focus is content creation and social media execution, the role will also involve light administrative and coordination tasks to support daily operations.



## Key Responsibilities



* Create engaging and visually cohesive content across Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, and other social platforms

* Edit high-quality short-form video content with strong pacing, storytelling, and aesthetic awareness

* Assist in developing and executing organic social strategies that support audience growth and brand positioning

* Write and refine captions, hooks, and marketing copy using AI-assisted workflows where appropriate

* Schedule and manage social media posting and community engagement

* Coordinate with creators, collaborators, and external partners when required

* Organise content pipelines, track deliverables, and maintain clear internal workflows

* Build and refine personal systems/SOPs to ensure consistency, accuracy, and attention to detail across recurring tasks

* Adapt quickly to new platforms, tools, and operational systems as the business evolves

* Provide light administrative support where required



## What We’re Looking For



* Strong experience in content creation and organic social media marketing

* Advanced video editing capabilities (CapCut experience essential)

* Exceptional aesthetic judgement and understanding of visual brand presentation

* Deep understanding of what performs organically across modern social platforms

* Experience working with fashion, jewellery, beauty, luxury, or lifestyle brands

* Ability to think independently and problem-solve without constant prompting

* Highly proactive with strong initiative and ownership mentality

* Strong organisational skills with the ability to create structure and systems independently

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills

* Ability to manage multiple moving parts while maintaining attention to detail



## Why Join Us?



* Be part of building a premium brand from the ground up

* Work directly alongside passionate founders in a highly creative environment

* Flexible remote working arrangement

* Opportunity for long-term growth into a senior marketing role

* Significant creative input and autonomy within the brand



If you’re deeply passionate about content, branding, storytelling, and organic social growth — and you have the aesthetic sensibility and initiative to operate at a high level — we’d love to hear from you.

title: Walmart Operations Lead
description:
Zoyava is a fast-growing digital-native supplement brand focused on building premium wellness products that consumers genuinely love. As we continue scaling across major eCommerce marketplaces, Walmart Marketplace has become a key strategic growth channel for the business.



We are looking for a highly experienced Walmart Operations Lead to take ownership of Walmart Marketplace performance, drive operational excellence, and help scale the channel into a major revenue driver for the company.



This is a leadership role for someone who understands Walmart deeply, thinks strategically about growth, communicates clearly with leadership, and can build scalable systems across catalog, advertising, inventory, promotions, and reporting.



Who We’re Looking For



We’re seeking a highly analytical, growth-oriented operator with deep Walmart Marketplace experience who can lead the day-to-day operations and long-term strategy of the Walmart channel.



This role is ideal for someone who has successfully scaled brands on Walmart Marketplace, understands Walmart Connect advertising, knows how to improve operational performance, and can proactively identify growth opportunities while keeping leadership informed through strong reporting and business insights.



You should be comfortable owning the Walmart business like it’s your own.



Key Responsibilities



Walmart Marketplace Ownership



• Lead and oversee all Walmart Marketplace operations across the brand.

• Own channel growth, revenue performance, profitability, and operational execution.

• Develop and execute Walmart growth strategies focused on sales expansion, margin improvement, and market share.

• Manage end-to-end catalog operations including listings, variations, compliance, SEO, inventory health, and pricing. • Ensure all listings are optimized for discoverability, conversion, and Walmart algorithm performance.

• Monitor account health, policy compliance, suppression risks, and operational KPIs.



Walmart Growth & Strategy



• Identify new opportunities for growth through assortment expansion, promotions, pricing strategies, search visibility, and advertising optimization.

• Analyze category trends, competitor activity, and Walmart platform changes to maintain competitive advantage.

• Develop launch strategies for new products and ensure successful execution on Walmart Marketplace.

• Drive initiatives that improve conversion rate, traffic, ROAS, contribution margin, and repeat purchase behavior.



Walmart Connect Advertising



• Lead Walmart Connect advertising strategy and execution.

• Oversee campaign structure, keyword targeting, bidding strategy, budget allocation, and scaling decisions.

• Continuously optimize ad efficiency and profitability through data analysis and testing.

• Report on advertising performance, attribution, TACOS, ROAS, and growth opportunities.



Leadership Reporting & Business Insights



• Build and maintain clear reporting systems for leadership.

• Provide weekly and monthly business updates with actionable insights, growth opportunities, risks, and operational recommendations.

• Track and report key Walmart KPIs including revenue, profitability, conversion rate, traffic, ROAS/TACOS, Buy Box %, inventory health, advertising efficiency, and listing health.

• Present strategic recommendations backed by data.



Cross-Functional Leadership



• Collaborate closely with creative, supply chain, operations, customer service, and leadership teams to ensure alignment across the Walmart business.

• Work with creative teams to improve listing assets, storefronts, and conversion-focused content.

• Coordinate with operations and inventory teams to maintain strong in-stock rates and avoid supply disruptions.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for Walmart account managers and external partners.



SOPs & Operational Excellence



• Develop scalable SOPs, workflows, and systems for Walmart operations.

• Improve operational efficiency across listing management, reporting, launches, and advertising workflows.

• Help build a world-class Walmart growth engine within the company. Skills & Requirements

• 4–7+ years of hands-on Walmart Marketplace experience with a proven track record of scaling brands.

• Deep understanding of Walmart Marketplace operations, catalog structure, SEO, and compliance.

• Strong experience managing Walmart Connect advertising at scale.

• Proven ability to analyze data and make growth-focused business decisions.

• Advanced Excel/Google Sheets reporting and analytical skills.

• Strong understanding of profitability, contribution margin, inventory planning, and marketplace economics.

• Exceptional communication and leadership skills.

• Highly organized with strong project management abilities.

• Ability to operate independently and take full ownership of results.

• Experience in supplements, wellness, CPG, or fast-paced eCommerce brands is highly preferred.

description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, proactive, and highly reliable Bookkeeper / Financial Accountant to join our team full-time. This role will support the financial operations of multiple entities, ensuring accurate bookkeeping, financial reporting, payroll processing, and compliance with Australian tax regulations.



The ideal candidate will have strong experience using XERO, excellent organisational skills, and the ability to work independently while managing sensitive financial information with a high level of confidentiality and professionalism.



This is a full-time role (5 days per week), and applicants must have reliable high-speed internet, a dedicated workspace suitable for confidential financial work, and proven Australian bookkeeping experience.



Key Responsibilities:



- Bookkeeping & Financial Records: Manage bookkeeping duties across multiple entities, ensuring all financial transactions are accurately recorded and maintained.

- Account Reconciliation: Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, loans, and other financial accounts regularly, ensuring discrepancies are identified and resolved promptly.

- Payments & Banking:  Handle day-to-day banking activities, including payment preparation, bank transfers, supplier payments, and reconciliation of receipts and deposits.

- Accounts Payable & Receivable: Generate and issue invoices, manage debtor follow-ups, process supplier invoices, and maintain accurate receipt documentation.

- Financial Reporting: Prepare balance sheets, profit and loss statements, cash flow reports, and other financial reports to support business decision-making.

- BAS & Compliance: Prepare and assist with BAS lodgements and ensure compliance with Australian tax obligations, GST requirements, payroll obligations, and statutory reporting.

- Payroll Processing: Process payroll accurately and on time, including superannuation, leave entitlements, PAYG obligations, and compliance with Australian employment requirements.

- Fixed Asset Register:  Maintain the fixed asset register and manage depreciation tracking.

- Data Accuracy & Irregularities: Identify, investigate, and report financial discrepancies or irregularities to management promptly.

- Confidentiality & Data Security: Maintain strict confidentiality of all company financial information and follow secure practices when handling sensitive business and employee data.



---



Key Requirements:

**Australian bookkeeping experience is essential** - applications without prior Australian bookkeeping/accounting experience will not be considered.

* Proven experience in bookkeeping and/or financial accounting roles, ideally across multiple entities or businesses.

* Strong proficiency in XERO, Microsoft Excel/spreadsheets, and financial systems.

* Solid understanding of Australian tax requirements, including GST, BAS, payroll, and superannuation obligations.

* Experience processing payroll in Australia.

* Exceptional attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills.

* Highly organised with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.

* Strong communication skills and ability to work autonomously.



Must have:

  * Reliable high-speed internet connection

  * A secure and quiet work environment

  * High level of reliability, responsiveness, and professionalism

  * Availability to work **full-time, 5 days per week**

  * Experience maintaining fixed asset registers and depreciation schedules is highly regarded.

title: Dispatch Operations Specialist
description:
AJG Transport (GH Logistics Affiliate) is a US based asset carrier operating 150+ company trucks on dedicated government contract freight. We run 365 days a year on consistent, contracted routes across 48 states. We're scaling fast with new markets, new lanes, new teams, and we need operators who can keep up.



This isn't a BPO. This isn't a call center. You'll be embedded in a real U.S. logistics operation working alongside American dispatchers, drivers, and carriers on live freight.



Role Overview

You're an operator working directly alongside our dispatch and freight management team, handling the higher complexity operational work that keeps our network running. Think of this as the role that handles what most people can't, the exceptions, the escalations, the details that make or break a load.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Book and coordinate loads across our network while ensuring proper carrier coverage, profitability, and operational efficiency. You own the load from booking through final delivery.

• Monitor and manage active loads across our network. Tracking, status updates, carrier and driver communication, and exception handling. You own the load from pickup to delivery.

• Verify data accuracy, documentation completeness, and process compliance across active loads. Catch problems before they become expensive.

• Conduct check calls, appointment scheduling, detention tracking, rate confirmations. You're the voice on the phone making sure freight moves on time.

• Respond to driver inquiries, route them to the right internal team, document issues. Drivers call with problems and you solve them or escalate them fast.

• Ensure accurate data on TMS for Loads, rates, stops, and documents. Everything in our systems needs to be accurate. You're the last line of defense before bad data creates bad decisions.

• Identify recurring issues, flag inefficiencies, and recommend fixes. We don't want someone who just follows a checklist. We want someone who makes the checklist better.

• Report daily and weekly ops summaries for US leadership.

• Know what you can solve vs. what needs to go up the chain, and route it fast. No sitting on problems.



Who We’re Looking For

• 2+ years experience in freight brokerage, dispatch, or logistics operations. NOT GENERAL VA WORK. We need someone who already knows what a BOL is, what detention means, and how a load moves from quote to delivery.

• Hands on experience with TMS platforms such as McLeod, Aljex, Turvo, or similar. If you've dispatched loads in a real system, we want to talk to you.

• Familiarity with load boards such as DAT, Truckstop, Highway or similar. You've sourced carriers or managed freight on these platforms before.

• Strong written and verbal English. You'll be on calls and email with US based drivers, carriers, and leadership daily. This is non negotiable.

• Night shift in PH availability — You'll work U.S. business hours. CST timezone alignment preferred (example: 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST/CDT = 8:00 PM – 6:00 AM PHT). 

• Self-directed. You don't wait to be told what to do. You see the problem, you fix it, you report it. If you need someone holding your hand, this isn't the role.



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: 7 AM – 5 PM CDT | 3 PM - 1 AM CDT | 11 PM - 9 AM CDT (San Antonio time)

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Zoom presence required (camera on throughout shift)

• Possible Hubstaff time tracking during shifts, but is not currently in use.



What You'll Get

• $7/hr USD. Paid consistently biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Growth path. 90 day performance review with opportunity to advance into senior operations roles as we scale. We're growing fast and the people who prove themselves early get the best opportunities.

• Direct access to U.S. executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager in Manila. You work directly with our operations team in Texas and Tennessee.

• Real operations work. Live freight, real drivers, real carriers, real money on the line. This isn't data entry with a fancy title.



Who Thrives Here

• People who've worked in a U.S. freight brokerage or 3PL and want something more stable

• Former dispatchers or carrier reps who are tired of BPO environments

• Operators who take ownership. You don't clock in and zone out. You run your loads like they are your business.

• People who want to grow into leadership but need the right company to do it in.



Who This Isn't For

• General VAs looking for easy remote work. This is real logistics and not admin tasks.

• People who need constant supervision or step by step instructions for every task

• Anyone who can't commit to US shift hours consistently

• Candidates without actual freight/logistics experience. We don't have time to teach the basics.
