title: Video Editor (Real Estate, Final Cut Pro)
description:
Lighthouse Visuals is hiring a senior video editor for real estate content. Remote, full-time, long-term.



About us

We're a high-volume real estate video production company. Our editors deliver 30+ videos a day across the team for top-tier US agents. We're expanding because demand keeps outpacing capacity.



What you'll do

You'll turn raw footage into the kind of edits clients ask for again and again. Format flexes by client need (vertical reels, horizontal cinematic cuts, teasers, walkthroughs, social shorts), but the bar stays the same. Every edit should feel intentional, well paced, and built to perform.



A typical edit includes:

- Organizing raw clips into clean folders (drones, wides, details, talking heads)

- Selecting music (Spotify, SoundCloud, remixes, trending audio) and timing cuts to it

- Building flow with speed ramps, optical flow, boomerangs, and Ryan Nangle transitions

- Color grading with LUTs and custom color wheels, masking for underexposed subjects

- Audio work: voice EQ through Adobe Podcasts, balancing dialog against music

- Motion blur where movement happens, not everywhere

- Tracking and lock-on stabilization for moving subjects



The style we hire for

We make engaging, fast-paced edits, but we're not the team that throws every effect on every clip. 



Hard requirements

- 3+ years professional video editing experience

- At least 1 year editing short-form social content (reels, TikTok, vertical)

- Final Cut Pro proficiency, or willingness to switch immediately from Premiere or DaVinci

- Mac with M-series chip, 16GB RAM minimum (24GB+ strongly preferred)

- Strong English, written and spoken

- Reliable high-speed internet (50 to 200GB project downloads)

- Portfolio with real estate, lifestyle, or fast-paced social work. Please don't apply with only wedding or long-form work



Highly preferred

Ryan Nangle transitions, Pixel Film Studios, Motion VFX, Adobe Podcasts,

What we offer

- Competitive Philippines-market salary with performance-based raises

- Long-term, stable work, not project-based

We are a growing D2C ecommerce company running paid ads on Meta 
 & Instagram) for multiple brands in beauty, health, and home goods. We are looking for a skilled Direct Response Video Editor to join our team for a long-term role.



This is not a brand video role. We create Meta video ads that drive sales — not videos that just look nice. We need someone who understands performance marketing and how to edit ads that convert.



ABOUT THE ROLE



You will edit short-for
ta ad creatives, VSLs, and AI-generated UGC ads for several D2C brands. You will also adapt winning ads for European markets — using AI tools to translate, dub, and localize content into different languages.



We start with part-time / hourly work, with the opportunity to grow into a full-time role within the first few months for the right person. Based on performance, you can also earn bonuses on winning ads.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



- Edit direct response Meta video ads (UGC-style, VSL, short-form, before/after, testimonials)

- Create AI UGC ads using AI avatars and AI-generated video

- Localize and translate ads for European markets using AI dubbing tools

- Edit long-form VSLs and create short-form cutdowns from them

- Add captions, hooks, sound design, B-roll, and pacing that holds attention

- Iterate quickly on winning ads — new hooks, new variations

- Communicate clearly with our team and follow creative briefs



REQUIRED SKILLS



- 2+ years of experience editing direct response or ecommerce Meta video ads (portfolio required)

- Strong understanding of Meta hooks, pacing, captions, and conversion structure

- Experience with AI video tools (Veo, Higgsfield, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Artlist, etc.)

- Experience with AI dubbing / video translation for multiple languages

- VSL editing experience

- Proficient in CapCut and/or Adobe Premiere Pro

- Strong written and spoken English

- Reliable, communicative, hits deadlines



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience in beauty, health/wellness, or home goods niches

- Motion graphics / After Effects skills

- Experience producing high-volume Meta ad creatives weekly



WHAT WE OFFER



- Long-term, stable work with a growing company

- Part-time hourly to start, with clear path to full-time

- Performance bonuses on winning ads

- Variety of work — multiple brands, multiple markets

- Training and access to advanced AI video tools and workflows

- Career growth as our brands scale



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. Your portfolio — 2-3 examples of direct response Meta ads you have edited (UGC, VSL, or short-form ads)

2. A short paragraph about your direct response editing experience

3. The AI tools you have used (even from personal projects)

4. Any experience with video translation / multilingual ads

5. Your hourly rate expectation and weekly availability

Please start your message with "DR-Editor" so we know you read the full post.



We are excited to find the right person to grow with us long-term.

title: Can you get a complete stranger to respond to a cold DM?
description:
Can you get a complete stranger to respond to a cold DM?



This isn't a role for someone who sends copy-paste messages and calls it outreach. We need someone who reads the room, adapts their approach, and actually knows what it takes to get a response.



*What this job is*

We're a fast-growing eCommerce company that partners with online content creators. We have a CRM full of creators ready to be contacted — your job is to reach them across X, Instagram, Reddit, and other platforms, start real conversations, and turn those conversations into partnerships. You'll write personalized outreach, manage follow-ups, keep the CRM updated, and test new angles when current ones stop working. Simple concept, genuinely hard to do well.



*Who we're looking for*

- Moves without being pushed — figures things out independently, doesn't wait for direction

- Writes like a human — warm, natural, persuasive English. We test this. ChatGPT applications go straight in the bin.

- Social media fluent — understands why some DMs get replies and most don't, and how tone shifts across platforms

- Persistent — treats low reply rates as a puzzle to solve, not a reason to slow down

- Tech-comfortable — picks up new tools quickly without needing hand-holding



*One thing we need to be upfront about*

This is a full-time, dedicated role — 100% of your focus, not a share of it. We'll ask directly about other clients during interviews and expect honesty. Strong performers earn bonuses and have real room to grow. We take good care of people who do good work and want to be here long-term.



*Here's how to apply*

Read the "Who we're looking for" section above. Do those points describe you? Tell us why — in your own words, not a template, not ChatGPT. We read every application personally and can immediately tell the difference. Be specific, be honest, write like yourself.

Resonance with our mission to build faith-led, traditional, value-driven brands

People who don't resonate with our mission of building traditional, faith-led, value-driven brands

title: Creative Project Manager + Meta Ads Copywriter – Full-Time
description:
IMPORTANT – READ BEFORE APPLYING



A 1-minute video introduction is REQUIRED to be considered for this role.

Applications without a video will NOT be reviewed.



You must submit a 1-minute video explaining:



Your experience managing creative or marketing projects



Your familiarity with video, ads, or content workflows



Why you believe you’re a strong fit for this role



No video = automatic rejection.

This requirement is repeated below intentionally.



About the Role



We are a performance-driven Meta ads agency producing high volumes of short-form video ads for service-based businesses.



We are hiring a Creative Project Manager + Meta Ads Copywriter who can both:



Write ad scripts for Meta 
 & Instagram), and



Manage creative flow and execution to ensure scripts, videos, and ads move smoothly through production.



This is a hybrid role that combines hands-on ad writing with ownership of creative workflow.



Ad Copy & Script Writing Responsibilities

You will write short-for
ta ad scripts designed to be spoken on camera for
 and Instagram. You will create modular ad scripts that include multiple hook variations, multiple pain or problem openings, and multiple call-to-action or offer endings. Scripts must sound natural, conversational, and clear when spoken, not like traditional marketing copy. You will follow defined frameworks, tone, and structure, and revise scripts quickly based on feedback and performance.



Creative Project Management Responsibilities

You will manage the creative production flow from script to video to final ad. This includes tracking deliverables across multiple clients, coordinating with editors, videographers, and internal tea
mbers, ensuring deadlines are met, identifying bottlenecks, and keeping projects moving without constant supervision. You will maintain organized project boards and documentation, ensure creative assets are complete and accurate, and perform basic quality control before assets move forward.



What This Role Does Not Include

This role does not include client strategy calls, offer creation or pricing decisions, media buying, ad account management, graphic design, or video editing.



Required Skills & Experience

You must have experience writing Meta or paid social ad copy and experience writing scripts meant to be spoken on camera. You should have a strong understanding of hooks, pacing, and short-form ad structure. Experience managing tasks, timelines, or creative workflows is required. Strong written and verbal English skills, high attention to detail, organization, and comfort following up with tea
mbers to maintain accountability are essential.



Preferred (Not Required)

Experience working in a marketing or advertising agency, familiarity with service-based business advertising, and experience using tools such as Notion, Slack, Google Drive, 
, ClickUp, Trello, or Asana are a plus.



Work Expectations

You must be available full-time during 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST, have a reliable internet connection, manage multiple priorities independently, take feedback well, and operate with a strong ownership mindset by proactively identifying and solving problems.



Compensation & Growth

Starting pay is $700/month USD, with performance-based increases available over time and long-term growth opportunities as the agency scales.



Application Instructions (Read Carefully)

To be considered, you MUST submit a 1-minute video introduction. In the video, explain your experience writing Meta ads or short-form video scripts, your experience managing creative tasks or workflows, and why you are a strong fit for this hybrid role. Upload the video via Loom, Google Drive, or YouTube (unlisted) and include the link in your application. Applications without a video will not be reviewed.



Written Questions

Please answer the following in your application: Have you written scripts specifically for Meta ads before? If yes, briefly describe. Have you managed creative projects or deadlines before? Are you able to work full-time from 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST (night shift in the Philippines)?



Final Note

This role requires both execution and ownership. You will be writing ads and ensuring creative production stays organized and on schedule. Applications without a 1-minute video will not be considered.

title: Senior Mobile App Developer (React) Remote | Work with a High-Quality Web Agency | Flexible Salary
description:
Senior Mobile App Developer (React) Remote | Work with a High-Quality Web Agency | Flexible Salary



We are looking for a highly skilled Mobile App Developer to join our team. The primary focus of this role will be mobile application development, but some projects may also involve front-end website work. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in building cross-platform apps and the ability to convert designs into clean, responsive, and pixel-perfect code.



Our Team Culture



Our company is based in New Zealand, and we have a talented remote team in the Philippines, mainly in Davao. 



Our team culture is extremely important to us. Since our company was founded in 2006, we’ve always taken care to recruit people who not only produce high-quality work but also care about the team. We have an amazing working relationship, and we are looking for someone who will contribute to that positive dynamic.



Responsibilities

 • Develop and maintain cross-platform mobile applications using Ionic (with Vue) and React Native

 • Work closely with designers to implement pixel-perfect UI from Figma design tools

 • Optimize applications for performance, responsiveness, and scalability

 • Integrate apps with REST APIs, GraphQL, and third-party services

 • Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging to ensure high-quality deliverables

 • Collaborate with the team on occasional website front-end projects (HTML/CSS/JavaScript/Vue/React)



Required Skills & Experience

 • Strong knowledge of React Native

 • Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript

 • Experience converting website designs into pixel-perfect, responsive HTML/CSS

 • Understanding of mobile app lifecycle, publishing to App Store/Google Play, and handling updates

 • Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, and async data handling

 • Experience with Git and version control workflows

 • Strong attention to detail and ability to deliver high-quality, maintainable code

 • Experience with Capacitor or Cordova plugins



Nice to Have

 • Knowledge of backend basics (Node.js, Firebase, Directus or similar)

 • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Appflow, EAS, or similar)

 • Understanding of web performance and accessibility best practices



Application Requirements



In your application letter, please:

1. Outline your experience – Specifically Mobile App Development but also Frontend website development

2. Explain why you’re suited to this role – Prove to us that you are both reliable and professional.

3. Please state your expected monthly salary.



If you have a keen eye for high quality and experienced with mobile app development, we’d love to hear from you!
